note: Prototype-level checks of the P03 viewer panel against the P02 flat panel; synthetic data.

results.name: 3D viewer right panel has exactly four tabs (Maintenance, Projects/Special, Technical, Spare parts) in a tablist, default Maintenance, no history anywhere

Flat/3D parity: for 7 selections x the three data tabs the 3D panel shows exactly the same current state as the flat view (ZMMS jobs today, open special jobs, spare-part register rows); counts and flags equal; Technical is the model-derived specification summary
results.detail: 21 tab/selection views identical in text; both pages read as Management so the write-only Add job button is absent in both (whole/maintenance:682, whole/special:654, whole/spareParts:3129, main 01/maintenance:682 ...)

results.name: The Technical tab of the 3D page is the specification summary of the selected area: part identity, semantic key, binding, provenance, source drawings; mechanism level lists its submechanisms and source-linked parameters; 63 m stays total lift and the 46 / 45.5 m/min conflict stays visible; the machinery house is a spatial group with no tab content
Tabs are keyboard-operable in the 3D page (arrows, Home/End, roving tab stop), the active tab is in the URL, and the tree selection is unchanged by tab changes

Selecting in the 3D scene (a real canvas click on a part) updates the panel to that part: scope title, Projects/Special for exactly that position, Spare parts row, tree and URL follow; the tab chosen stays

Open in Jobs from the 3D page opens the P02 EQ Jobs tab with the same equipment and scope, as the same read-only Management persona the viewer page runs as; job numbers link there too [Repair-R02B finding 7: was role=eqTeam]
Fallbacks keep the four tabs usable: no WebGL (simulated) shows the fallback list and the tabs; the panel needs no WebGL
The 3D page panel at 1920x1080, 1366x768, tablet and phone: no horizontal page overflow, tabs visible and unclipped, no console errors
